verdict.rationale: Baseten ships its own skill and MCP servers so a user's coding agent can manage the Baseten workspace. That gives a first-party path to operating the product through natural-language commands, but it is delegated to an external agent rather than a built-in natural-language interface, and the evidence does not say which operations are covered. Function calling and Switch routing concern the models Baseten serves, not operating the platform, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language console or assistant, documentation of which workspace operations the agent and MCP tools can perform, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so your coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search these docs.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.baseten.co/agent-setup
